personal_info.title: AI & Automation Engineer · Digital Transformation Lead
personal_info.tagline: I build and run production AI and automation systems for a four-brand group, partnering with owners on strategy and delivery.

habitai_unified_platform.title: HABITAI · Unified Operations Platform
habitai_unified_platform.problem: Operations data lived in ERP, CRM, logistics, and spreadsheets with no single place for owners or field teams to act.
habitai_unified_platform.built: Operations cockpit tying PHC data, CRM sync, automation, inventory signals, and agent-assisted Q&A on governed metrics.

phc_cloud_data_platform_elt.title: PHC ERP · Cloud Read Replica
phc_cloud_data_platform_elt.problem: CRM and automations could not safely use live ERP data without exposing on-prem SQL or copying numbers by hand.
phc_cloud_data_platform_elt.built: Hybrid sync to PostgreSQL on a VPS, dbt marts, role-scoped access, and executive dashboards for two PHC tenants.

blinds_field_ops_pwa.title: app-tecnicos · Field Operations PWA
blinds_field_ops_pwa.problem: Field service ran on paper: slow customer updates, lost technician time, and no shared schedule when clients called.
blinds_field_ops_pwa.built: Production PWA with offline queue, maps and routing, warehouse module, and Twenty CRM sync on Hetzner.

orcamentos_ia_platform.title: orcamentos-ia · Multi-Supplier Quoting
orcamentos_ia_platform.problem: Quotes depended on manual PDF and spreadsheet work; sales waited days while prices had to stay auditable.
orcamentos_ia_platform.built: FastAPI and React platform with supplier plug-ins, deterministic pricing tiers, PDF ingestion, and CRM handoff.

alygen_crm_b2b.title: Alygen CRM · B2B Outreach Stack
alygen_crm_b2b.problem: Freelance prospecting meant hours of manual site audits and slow, generic proposals per lead.
alygen_crm_b2b.built: Open-source CRM with automated technical audits, ML lead scoring, agent-assisted copy, and email and messaging dispatch.

container_risk_radar_habitarmos.title: Container Risk Radar · Fleet Observability
container_risk_radar_habitarmos.problem: Websites, VPS hosts, containers, and automations were monitored in separate tools with no shared risk picture.
container_risk_radar_habitarmos.built: Docker Compose observability stack with Prometheus, Loki, Grafana, scoring engine, and a Next.js control dashboard.
